### How to submit / 提交说明
1. 保留下面的组会元数据。 / Keep the seminar metadata below.
2. 如果某项已经有 URL，就不需要再上传该文件。 / If a URL is already listed, no upload is needed for that item.
3. 如需提交封面图、PPT 或 PDF 文件，请点击对应 Attachment / 附件区域下方，并把文件拖入 GitHub Issue 编辑器；GitHub 会自动插入上传链接。 / To submit a cover image, PPT, or PDF file, click under the matching Attachment section and drag the file into this GitHub issue editor. GitHub will insert an upload link there.
4. 点击 Submit new issue / 提交新 Issue。自动流程会把 GitHub 附件复制到本仓库。 / Click Submit new issue. The workflow will copy GitHub attachments into this repository.
